title: Extend an initial horseshoe embedding to exact rows of complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $S=(A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C)$ be a short exact sequence. Fix injective resolutions $s_A:A\to I_A^\bullet$ and $s_C:C\to I_C^\bullet$, indexed by $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Fix a morphism $t:B\to I_A^0$ satisfying $f\,t=s_A^0$ (diagrammatic composition order). There exist a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ indexed by $\mathbf N$, an augmentation $s_B:B[0]\to K^\bullet$, and complex maps $\alpha:I_A^\bullet\to K^\bullet$, $\beta:K^\bullet\to I_C^\bullet$ such that $s_A\alpha=f[0]s_B$, $s_B\beta=g[0]s_C$, and $\alpha\beta=0$. Each row $I_A^n\to K^n\to I_C^n$ is short exact. There is an isomorphism $e_0:K^0\simeq I_A^0\oplus I_C^0$ with $s_B^0 e_0=(t,g s_C^0)$, and the sequence $B\xrightarrow{s_B^0}K^0\xrightarrow{d_K^0}K^1$ is exact. The conclusion does not assert injectivity of $K^n$, positive-degree exactness of $K$, or that $s_B$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 013T (lemma-injective-resolution-ses), proof Step 2; object specialization by the prescribed-endpoint cokernel induction of lem-sp-horseshoe-prescribed-resolutions, Steps 2--3.

proof.text: Set K^0=I_A^0⊕I_C^0 and w=(t,g s_C^0). The equation f t=s_A^0 and fg=0 give the two commutative squares with the split biproduct row. The outer augmentations are mono. The snake lemma makes w mono and gives a short exact sequence of its three cokernels.

source.place: Tag 013T (lemma-injective-resolution-ses), proof Step 2; object specialization by the prescribed-endpoint cokernel induction of lem-sp-horseshoe-prescribed-resolutions, Steps 2--3.

proof.text: Exactness of each prescribed outer resolution gives a monomorphism from the cokernel of its augmentation into its degree-one term. Apply injectivity of I_A^1 to extend the left cokernel embedding across the first map of the cokernel short exact sequence. Pair this extension with the right cokernel embedding composed with the second map to obtain the next middle embedding into I_A^1⊕I_C^1. Apply the snake lemma to obtain the next short exact cokernel sequence. Repeat this operation recursively with the cokernels and the next prescribed outer terms. At step n, the chosen middle object is I_A^n⊕I_C^n, and the new maps on cokernels commute with the inclusions and projections.

source.place: Tag 013T (lemma-injective-resolution-ses), proof Step 2; object specialization by the prescribed-endpoint cokernel induction of lem-sp-horseshoe-prescribed-resolutions, Steps 2--3.

proof.text: Define d_K^n as the quotient from K^n to the current middle cokernel followed by its embedding into K^(n+1). Its composite with the next differential is zero because the next quotient kills this embedding. The cokernel squares and the embedding squares show that the outer inclusions and projections commute with these differentials. They therefore define complex maps α and β with αβ=0; the initial squares give the augmentation equations. Every row is the canonical split biproduct row. The identity of K^0 with the initial biproduct gives e_0 and the required equality.

source.place: Tag 013T (lemma-injective-resolution-ses), proof Step 2; object specialization by the prescribed-endpoint cokernel induction of lem-sp-horseshoe-prescribed-resolutions, Steps 2--3.

proof.text: The first differential is the quotient onto Coker(w) followed by a monomorphism. Thus its kernel is the image of w, and B → K^0 → K^1 is exact. The equation w d_K^0=0 determines the augmentation B[0] → K. No verification of positive-degree exactness, termwise injectivity, or quasi-isomorphism is needed for this construction statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_horseshoe_prescribed_rows
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (lift : S.X₂ ⟶ IA.cocomplex.X 0) (hlift : S.f ≫ lift = IA.ι.f 0) :
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex C ℕ)
      (ι : (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj S.X₂ ⟶ K)
      (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ K) (β : K ⟶ IC.cocomplex),
      IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.f ≫ ι ∧
      ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.g ≫ IC.ι ∧
      (∃ e₀ : K.X 0 ≅ IA.cocomplex.X 0 ⊞ IC.cocomplex.X 0,
        ι.f 0 ≫ e₀.hom = biprod.lift lift (S.g ≫ IC.ι.f 0)) ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk (ι.f 0) (K.d 0 1) (by simp)).Exact ∧
      ∃ (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0), ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
          (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact
